name: Nadia
self_text: I am a Canadian non-binary person in my mid 30s with a background in biology. In my spare time, I love growing chillies. I am looking for in person language practice. We can study independently side by side and talk things through as we go. There is no tutoring either way. I am available Sunday morning or Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into working through problems together. It would be nice if you are okay with occasional short exchanges or talking things through as we go. Additionally, it's a small bonus if you are available any of Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning.
